title: Go 1.27 image variant with a C toolchain for cgo / -race (golang:1.27-cgo)
description:
ocidex wants unit tests run with the race detector in CI (ocidex-gyr0.4). 'go test -race' requires cgo on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 ('go: -race requires cgo', verified 2026-10-16), and golang:1.27 is base + go only: no C compiler, so CGO is off and -race cannot build.

Add a variant rather than growing golang:1.27, which every Go CI task pulls: languages/golang/1.27-cgo.yaml = the 1.27 image plus gcc and glibc-dev (or wolfi build-base if that is the smaller correct set), published as ghcr.io/pfenerty/apko-cicd/golang:1.27-cgo, with lock file, Makefile IMAGE entry and the usual signing. Keep CGO_ENABLED unset in the image (consumers set CGO_ENABLED=1 in the task env) so it behaves like golang:1.27 otherwise.
acceptance_criteria:
- golang:1.27-cgo is published for amd64 and arm64 and signed like the other images.
- In it, CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race on a trivial package passes as uid 1024.
- README / image list mention the variant and why it exists.
notes: Parent epic: plan-cps (common hub). Blocks ocidex-gyr0.4.

title: Add tools-kyverno image (Kyverno CLI + Helm)
description:
ocidex needs a CI image carrying both the Kyverno CLI and Helm so its helm-check task can render the charts and validate the result against the PodSecurity restricted profile in one step.

Upstream ghcr.io/kyverno/kyverno-cli is not usable: the homelab cluster ghcr-docker-config only covers pfenerty/*, so any other GHCR org 403s on pull, and Kyverno publishes no Docker Hub mirror. Wolfi has both packages (kyverno-cli-1.18 -> 1.18.1, helm-4 -> 4.2.4), so this follows the same path as syft/grype/semgrep/gitleaks.

Consumer: ocidex-9yq4 (helm lint + PodSecurity render check in CI), which references ghcr.io/pfenerty/apko-cicd/kyverno:1.18.1-helm4.
acceptance_criteria: tools/kyverno/apko.yaml + apko.lock.json committed; Makefile IMAGE entry present; make publish-tools-kyverno pushes ghcr.io/pfenerty/apko-cicd/kyverno:1.18.1-helm4; ocidex helm-check TaskRun pulls it successfully in ocidex-ci
close_reason: tools/kyverno is on main. ocidex helm-check consumes ghcr.io/pfenerty/apko-cicd/kyverno:1.18.1-helm4 (.tektonic/shared.ts).

title: Enable binfmt_misc/qemu on Talos nodes (blocks multi-arch gosec)
description: The gosec melange build (tools/gosec/melange.yaml, --arch amd64,arm64) fails cross-arch on the Talos cluster: 'cannot mount binfmt_misc filesystem: no such device' and 'bwrap: execvp /bin/sh: Exec format error arch=aarch64'. Native amd64 build is validated working. To publish multi-arch gosec, enable binfmt_misc + qemu-user emulation on the Talos nodes. THIS IS HOMELAB REPO WORK (Talos machine-config / system extension), not apko-cicd. Once nodes expose binfmt_misc, the existing gosec task builds both arches unchanged. Verify with: privileged TaskRun running 'melange build tools/gosec/melange.yaml --arch amd64,arm64'.
close_reason: Duplicate of homelab-ep8. Talos binfmt work lives in homelab; its acceptance now includes the multi-arch gosec melange build.

title: Bake apko into base/tools image instead of downloading at runtime
description: Migrated from common/plan-idc (apko-cicd Beads DB was missing its issue_prefix; fixed via bd init --prefix apko-cicd). .tekton/tasks/publish-changed-images.k8s.yaml:34-44 downloads the apko binary from GitHub releases on every pipeline run (~5-10s, external dependency, network-failure risk). Build apko into an apko-cicd image (base/tools target) and reference it in the publish task instead. Parent epic: plan-bpo (in common).
acceptance_criteria: apko available in an apko-cicd image; publish-changed-images task no longer downloads apko at runtime; a PAC push run still publishes changed images successfully.
close_reason: Done: the publish job runs apko from ghcr.io/pfenerty/apko-cicd/apko (build-publish-image task), so nothing downloads at runtime.

value: apko lock files checksum the whole config YAML (annotations included): any edit to an apko yaml requires re-running 'apko lock <yaml>' or publish fails with 'checksum in the lock file ... does not matches'.

gosec is NOT a Wolfi package (govulncheck IS). gosec images are built by melange from source (tools/gosec/melange.yaml) and consumed via a local @local apko repo. melange only runs on Linux, so 'make melange-gosec' can't run on macOS dev machines — it runs in the Tekton pipeline. apko MERGES include'd repositories/keyring (confirmed), so gosec configs only add the @local repo on top of the Wolfi base.

tektonic (@pfenerty/tektonic) has NO scheduled/cron trigger — only push/PR/tag GitHub events. The daily package-update job was migrated off GitHub Actions to a triggerless Tekton pipeline (TektonProject, isolated outdir .tekton/update/) started by a standalone CronJob (.tekton/update-packages-cronjob.yaml). melange steps run privileged (bubblewrap) — NOT yet validated against the Talos node userns policy. Needs github-automerge-token secret + branch protection on main.

VALIDATED on homelab cluster (admin@rpi-cluster, Talos, 3x arm64 + 1x amd64): melange gosec build works NATIVELY in a privileged Tekton step after (1) apk add bubblewrap in base:stable and (2) declaring Wolfi repo+keyring in melange.yaml environment. BLOCKER for multi-arch: Talos nodes lack binfmt_misc ('cannot mount binfmt_misc filesystem: no such device'), so qemu cross-arch (arm64 on amd64 node) fails with 'bwrap: execvp /bin/sh: Exec format error'. local-path storage is RWO so no cross-node shared workspace either. Multi-arch gosec needs binfmt enabled on Talos (homelab infra change) OR per-arch native builds. apko-cicd-ci namespace PSA enforce=privileged (privileged pods allowed). Repo is public (clones unauthenticated).
